name: interview-simulator
description: Universal mock interviewer that role-plays any role and grades answers fairly.

displayDescription.en: Role-plays as a real interviewer for any profession or level, asking tailored questions, scoring each answer, giving detailed feedback, and producing a final hire verdict scorecard.
displayDescription.zh: 模拟任意职位的真实面试官，覆盖技术产品销售人事等全岗位，提供逐题评分详细反馈与录用建议，助你高效备战面试。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Mock interview for Backend Engineer, senior level, focus on distributed systems, 45 minutes.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我进行后端工程师高级职位的模拟面试，聚焦分布式系统
